answer: Delayed-episode vault release.** Each identity accrues copper credits only through verified spaced sessions; credits unlock from a per-identity vault after irregular quartz-timed intervals the agent cannot predict or compress. Because rewards require sustained returns over weeks and early withdrawal forfeits accrued credit, an attacker running N sybils pays N times the wall-clock attention cost plus idle capital locked per identity, making mass fabrication economically worse than operating one honest agent.
